UnitStatement: The canonical-hash parity corpus test (H1/verification F-5a) pins the engine's canonical JSON form as RFC 8785 (JCS) since H5.
fixtures/canonical_hash/cases.json pins the engine's RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON form — UTF-16-sorted keys, ECMAScript number rendering — and its SHA-256 for invented inputs.
The native canonical-hash test is the blessing authority; run CANONICAL_HASH_BLESS=1 cargo test to regenerate expectations, then review the diff.

The desktop Vitest suite replays the same canonical-hash cases through the wasm exports canonical_json_string and canonical_sha256_hex, proving native and wasm lanes agree byte-for-byte on the same input text.
Canonical-hash cases carry their input as a raw JSON string so both lanes parse identical text; number rendering (1e9 to 1000000000, 200.0 to 200) is part of the pinned behavior.
The parity test imports canonical_json and sha256_hex from the open_pipe_stress_operation_applier crate.
The canonical-hash parity corpus enforces a coverage floor of at least 20 cases.
For each case the test parses input_json, computes canonical_json then sha256_hex, and asserts the result matches expected_canonical and expected_sha256.
In bless mode the test rewrites each case with the newly computed expected_canonical and expected_sha256 and writes the pretty-printed corpus back to disk.

The cross-engine operation contract corpus runner (TP-SEAM-CORPUS-001) executes every case in fixtures/model_operations/contract_corpus/ through the crate's validate_operation/apply_operation seam and asserts the recorded outcome.

The same contract corpus case files are executed by the browser-mirror engine in apps/desktop/src/services/operationContractCorpus.test.ts under the same comparison rules, holding both engines to identical semantic outcomes and one shared canonical hash.

Contract comparison uses exact equality on semantic fields: validation states, diff rows, diagnostics (code/severity/blocking/affected_refs compared order-insensitively), acceptance, audit/professional boundary, model-basis claim echoes, and identity echoes.
Engine-identity fields are excluded only via the documented allowlist: application_route, diagnostics[].id, diagnostics[].source, diagnostics[].message, diagnostics[].remediation.
Since H5 the engine canonicalization is RFC 8785 (JCS), so model_basis.backend_model_hash and applied_model_backend_hash values are now full byte-equality comparisons across every lane.
Applied model documents are compared both as parsed-JSON deep equality (numbers compared by f64 value) and by the engine's own canonical hash (canonical_json + sha256_hex).
The prior ECMA harness renderers that approximated a transport-invariant hash (Rust + TS twins) are retired because the engine rendering is now transport-invariant.
Contract corpus expected outcomes are regenerated from the Rust crate (the contract reference) via CORPUS_BLESS=1 cargo test, and blessed output requires human review before being relied on.
All contract corpus data is invented (PUBLIC_DOMAIN_OR_ORIGINAL); no protected standards content and no compliance/certification/approval claims.

The contract corpus enforces 19 required accepted operation kinds including set_field, update_load, create_node, delete_node, connect_pipe_run, create_section, create_material, create_load_case, create_combination, and delete_combination_term.

The contract corpus enforces 14 required blocking codes including OP-TARGET-ALREADY-EXISTS, OP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND, OP-UNIT-MISMATCH-CONVERSION-UNAVAILABLE, OP-STALE-BEFORE-VALUE, OP-VALUE-NOT-NUMERIC, and OP-NODE-DELETE-REFERENCED.

engine_canonical_hash returns sha256:<hex> from sha256_hex(canonical_json(value)); since H5 the JCS canonicalization is transport-invariant so one formula serves both blessed-value comparison and engine self-consistency.
json_semantically_equal performs parsed-JSON deep equality with numbers compared by f64 value so an integer literal and the same float literal compare equal.
semantic_outcome projects the engine outcome onto the cross-engine semantic comparison surface, mirrored exactly by semanticOutcome in the Vitest runner.
Projected diagnostics are reduced to code/severity/blocking/affected_refs and sorted by a stable diagnostic_sort_key combining code, affected_refs, and severity.
run_case asserts the input base_model is never mutated by validate_operation or apply_operation by comparing it to a pre-call snapshot.

For applied cases the test asserts the applied model deep-equals the expected document, the engine canonical hash matches the recorded hash, and applied_model_backend_hash byte-equals the blessed hash in every lane (H5 full byte-equality).
For blocked applies the test asserts no applied_model, no recorded applied-model hash, and no applied_model_backend_hash.

The corpus coverage test asserts every required accepted kind and every required blocking code is exercised, plus accepted and blocked cases for dynamic paths primitive_loads.N.magnitude.value and terms.N.factor.
The validation_preview package provides operation validation and deterministic diff preview helpers.
validation_preview exports PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY, VALIDATION_PREVIEW_VERSION, canonical_json, and validate_and_preview_operations from its engine module.
The validation preview engine (DEL-16-02) validates proposed operation records and produces deterministic preview deltas against an accepted model-state snapshot.
The validation preview engine never mutates the accepted input state and never treats a preview as an accepted technical result.
VALIDATION_PREVIEW_VERSION is 0.1.0.
Supported operation kinds are add, move, modify, delete, reconnect, constraint, load, support, and design_knowledge.
Supported change kinds are add_object, remove_object, set_field, move_geometry, reconnect, update_constraint, update_load, update_support, and attach_design_knowledge.

The validation preview engine defines a canonical dimension vocabulary including dimensionless, length, force, moment, pressure, stress, second_moment_area, section_modulus, linear_stiffness, rotational_stiffness, and TBD.
PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY records human_review_required=True and that the software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.

ENGINE_PROVENANCE records source name, location, project-governed license, contributor certification implementation-only-no-professional-claim, public_permissive redistribution, pending review, and public_metadata privacy.
validate_and_preview_operations validates a structured operation envelope against an accepted model state and returns a deterministic preview, accepting optional constraint_diagnostics.
The engine deep-copies the accepted model state as its working source_state so the original input is never mutated.
The engine aggregates diagnostics from envelope validation, schema validation, model-basis checks, and constraint diagnostics.
An operation with any blocking diagnostic produces a blocked preview row and its changes are not previewed.
The preview result is tagged deliverable DEL-16-02, package PKG-16, scope SOW-069, and objective OBJ-015.
The result validation block reports schema_validation, constraint_validation, unit_validation, diff_preview_status, and application_status, with application_status set to not_applied.
diff_preview rows are sorted by canonical_json and diagnostics are stably sorted; the result also reports accepted_model_state_unchanged.
canonical_json serializes preview output as JSON with sort_keys=True, compact separators, and ensure_ascii=True for stable key ordering.
Operation validation requires the envelope deliverable_id to be DEL-16-01, otherwise it emits OP-UPSTREAM-SCHEMA-BINDING; validation consumes DEL-16-01 structured operation records.
The envelope must contain schema_version, deliverable_id, package_id, scope_item, objectives, and operation_set; each missing field emits OP-ENVELOPE-FIELD-MISSING.
Schema diagnostics validate the envelope against schemas/model_operation.schema.json using a JSON Schema 2020-12 validator; a missing validator emits OP-SCHEMA-VALIDATOR-MISSING.

Model-basis diagnostics require the operation set to bind to a physical_source_of_truth model role and a current model-state hash, emitting OP-MODEL-BASIS-MISSING or OP-MODEL-ROLE-BLOCKED when absent or wrong.
When the operation model-basis accepted_model_state_hash does not match the current accepted model state hash, the engine emits OP-MODEL-BASIS-HASH-MISMATCH.
Each operation must include preconditions with a required_current_hashes entry scoped to model_state_record matching the current state hash, else OP-CURRENT-HASH-MISSING or OP-CURRENT-HASH-MISMATCH.
An operation_kind outside SUPPORTED_OPERATION_KINDS emits OP-KIND-UNSUPPORTED.
An operation that requests direct accepted-model mutation emits OP-DIRECT-MUTATION-BLOCKED; operations stay structured proposals for validation, preview, and later user review.
A change_kind outside SUPPORTED_CHANGE_KINDS emits OP-CHANGE-KIND-UNSUPPORTED.
A change missing a structured value_payload mapping emits OP-PAYLOAD-MISSING.
Quantity-kind payloads require complete value, unit, and dimension metadata, emitting OP-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING when incomplete.
Quantity payloads whose dimension is outside the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary emit OP-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN.
For remove_object, set_field, move_geometry, and reconnect changes, a target id absent from the entity index emits OP-TARGET-REF-UNRESOLVED.

_preview_change computes a deterministic before/after delta: add_object builds an object from payload, remove_object sets after to None, otherwise it patches the existing object, and unresolved targets are blocked_by_validation.
_blocked_preview emits a preview row with change_kind blocked_by_validation and the sorted blocking diagnostic codes.
_entity_index builds an id-keyed map of accepted-state entities, reading from entities or model_state.entities.
_patched_object applies structured_values, scalar_values, and quantity_values from the payload as preview overlays on a deep copy of the entity.
_direct_mutation_requested flags operations whose validation application_status is outside the allowed set or whose operation_status is agent_accepted_engineering_state or auto_approved.
_quantity_has_units treats a mapping as having units only when it contains value, unit, and dimension keys.

The solver-boundary adapter accepts canonical analytical_solver_model mappings and emits plain deterministic records for lower solver-boundary orchestration; it is not a public API, CLI, preview runtime, or load engine.
The adapter contract id is DEL-13-04-internal-analytical-solver-boundary-adapter-0.1, with axes (X,Y,Z), DOF axes (UX,UY,UZ,RX,RY,RZ), and a vector tolerance of 1.0e-12.

LOAD_RECORD_CONTRACTS defines four canonical load record types: nodal_force, nodal_moment, element_point_force, and element_uniform_distributed_force, each with required keys, target type, quantity dimension, and direction axes.

Material property dimensions require elastic_modulus and shear_modulus as stress; section property dimensions require area, second_moment_y, second_moment_z, and torsion_constant; mass_per_length is optional.

SolverBoundaryAdapterResult is a frozen dataclass DTO carrying nodes, straight_pipe_connectivity, property_bindings, support_targets, load_case_records, load_applications, adapter_dto_records, and diagnostics.
SolverBoundaryAdapterResult.has_blocking_findings is True when any diagnostic or load-case diagnostic has severity blocking.
adapt_analytical_solver_model adapts a strict analytical solver model into deterministic DTO records.
A non-mapping analytical model input emits blocking ASBA-SOURCE-MODEL-MISSING and returns an empty result.
An analytical model whose model_role is not analytical_solver_model emits blocking ASBA-SOURCE-ROLE-UNEXPECTED.

_adapt_nodes requires id, coordinates, and degrees_of_freedom, emits ASBA-NODE-DOF-UNRESOLVED when any DOF axis is None/empty/TBD, and adapts each node into indexed coordinate values, units, and quantities.

_adapt_straight_pipes requires straight_pipe elements with resolvable start/end node, material, section, and a canonical cartesian local_coordinate_system; non-straight-pipe types emit ASBA-ELEMENT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED.
Straight-pipe connectivity requires an explicit cartesian local coordinate system; absence emits ASBA-ELEMENT-LOCAL-COORDINATE-SYSTEM-UNSUPPORTED.
The local_coordinate_system must contain exactly type, axes, y_reference, and provenance; extra keys emit ASBA-ELEMENT-LOCAL-COORDINATE-SYSTEM-NONCANONICAL.
Local axes other than canonical X/Y/Z emit ASBA-ELEMENT-LOCAL-AXES-UNSUPPORTED.
An adapted straight pipe records derived_axis_x from start/end coordinates, the y_reference vector, and solver_orientation_status governed_y_reference_ready.
_adapt_property_bindings binds each straight pipe to its required material and section quantity properties plus optional section properties, producing a BIND-STRAIGHT-PIPE binding record.

_adapt_supports requires id, support_type, target_ref, directions, and properties; directions must be explicit DOF axes (ASBA-SUPPORT-DIRECTIONS-UNSUPPORTED) and the target must resolve to an adapted node or element (ASBA-SUPPORT-TARGET-UNRESOLVED).

_adapt_load_cases validates each load case and its loads, emitting load applications only for fully canonical resolvable loads and marking the load case solver_ready only when all loads emit with no diagnostics.
A load record_type not in the canonical union emits ASBA-LOAD-RECORD-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED, and noncanonical extra keys emit ASBA-LOAD-NONCANONICAL-SEMANTICS-UNSUPPORTED.
Each load's quantity must match the contract quantity dimension and its direction must be in the contract direction axes (ASBA-LOAD-DIRECTION-UNSUPPORTED).
element_point_force loads require a dimensionless station_fraction quantity; element_uniform_distributed_force loads require a validated span.
_orientation_diagnostics validates that a finite nonzero local X axis exists and that y_reference is three finite numeric components, nonzero, and not parallel to the derived X axis.
_derived_axis_x returns the normalized direction vector between two 3D coordinate lists, or None when the separation length is within tolerance.

_span requires start_fraction and end_fraction dimensionless quantities, both in [0,1] with start_fraction < end_fraction, emitting span range and order diagnostics since JSON Schema cannot compare sibling values.
_norm computes the Euclidean norm and _cross computes the 3D vector cross product.
_adapter_dto_identity_records builds a sorted DTO identity record per load application with a JCS sha256 payload_hash and a two-step source_chain from analytical model to adapter DTO to solver input.
_stable_payload_hash computes a sha256 hex digest over the JSON-encoded value with sorted keys, compact separators, and allow_nan=False.

_quantity validates a canonical Quantity requiring value, unit, dimension, and provenance, a finite numeric value, explicit non-TBD unit/dimension, and a matching expected dimension, with a distinct diagnostic per failure.
The adapter does not convert or infer units and does not reinterpret dimensions; a quantity dimension mismatch emits a DIMENSION-UNSUPPORTED diagnostic.
_ref builds an object reference mapping of object_type and id with spaces replaced by hyphens.
The adapter _diagnostic record carries code, class (SOLVE_BLOCKING or ASSUMPTION_WARNING), severity, source, affected_object, message, and remediation.
The physical-to-analytical transform contract derives a solver-oriented centerline/frame model from a supplied physical source model and is provider-neutral.
Incomplete or non-representable inputs become deterministic diagnostics instead of inferred engineering defaults.
Centerline element types are straight_pipe, frame, and rigid; supported analytical metadata component types are rigid, valve, flange, reducer, and specialty.
Supported support types are anchor, guide, line_stop, restraint, spring, gap, and friction.
TransformSettings carries stable analytical_model_id, analytical_model_name, and contract_version DEL-13-04-0.1 into deterministic output identity.
TransformResult carries the analytical_model, diagnostics, and traceability_links, with has_blocking_findings True when any diagnostic severity is blocking.
transform_physical_to_analytical derives a deterministic analytical model from a physical source model without mutating the source; non-representable records are omitted with traceable diagnostics.
A non-mapping physical model input emits blocking PTA-SOURCE-MODEL-MISSING and returns an empty analytical model.
A physical model whose model_role is not physical_source_of_truth emits the warning PTA-SOURCE-ROLE-UNEXPECTED.
A missing or TBD coordinate_system emits blocking PTA-COORDINATE-SYSTEM-MISSING; the transform does not infer a coordinate system.

The derived analytical model has model_role analytical_solver_model and carries nodes, elements, components, materials, sections, supports, load_cases, combinations, stable diagnostics, and traceability links.
_copy_nodes requires id, coordinates, and degrees_of_freedom with resolved unit and DOF gaps; an absent or empty node list emits blocking PTA-NODES-MISSING.
_copy_records_with_units copies materials and sections only when their quantity-bearing fields have resolved unit metadata, emitting unit gap diagnostics otherwise.
_classify_components requires id, component_type, geometry, mechanics_modifiers, and provenance; unsupported component types emit the warning PTA-COMPONENT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED and are excluded.

_copy_elements validates element fields and references, blocking on unresolved node/material/section refs and on component_ref that does not resolve to a supported analytical metadata component (PTA-ELEMENT-COMPONENT-UNSUPPORTED).
An element_type outside the centerline/frame types emits the warning PTA-ELEMENT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED unless it is a component_link to a known component.
_copy_supports validates support fields and target references and emits PTA-SUPPORT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED for support types outside the supported set.
_copy_load_cases validates load case fields and each load's target reference and quantity units, blocking on unresolved targets or unit gaps.

_quantity_gaps recursively inspects unit-bearing values, emitting a unit diagnostic for missing/TBD unit or dimension and PTA-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN for dimensions outside the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary.
_dof_gaps requires a degrees_of_freedom mapping with explicit non-TBD states for all six DOF axes, emitting PTA-NODE-DOF-MISSING or PTA-NODE-DOF-UNRESOLVED; no restraint defaults are inferred.
_reference_gap emits a blocking SOLVE_BLOCKING diagnostic when a referenced record id is missing or not present among known ids.
_trace_link builds a physical_to_analytical traceability link from source to target (or to a synthesized Diagnostic target) with provenance.
_stable_traceability deterministically orders links and attaches the matching diagnostic to links whose target object_type is Diagnostic.
The contract _ref coerces object_type to TBD unless it is one of the known types Project, Model, Node, Element, Component, Material, Section, Support, LoadCase, Combination, or Diagnostic.
The open_pipe_stress_product_physics crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021, publish=false) is the product-preview physics adapter for OpenPipeStress.
product_physics depends on the frame_kernel, load_case_algebra, linear_supports, primitive_loads, straight_pipe, stress_recovery, and units crates plus serde and serde_json.
The product_physics preview_result example loads the invented_preview_model.json fixture into a PreviewModel.
The preview example runs run_linear_static_preview with an empty materials list and prints the pretty-printed JSON result.
